how: The only luge track in China is the Yanqing National Sliding Centre near Beijing, roughly 1,000 km away (about 2.5 hours by flight or 5 hours by high-speed rail plus transfer); Shanghai has no sliding track.
L*SNOW Indoor Skiing Theme Resort in Pudong's Nanhui area (Dishui Lake) is a very large indoor ski and snow resort, roughly 55-60 km southeast of the centre.
Shanghai Wild Animal Park in Pudong has a vehicle-entry drive-through zone among free-roaming animals plus walk-through areas; it is a safari-style park, not wild safari.
A sports centre named Magic Jungle (Mo Du Ju Zhen) near Lujiazui is tagged as a climbing-adventure facility in OpenStreetMap; the exact format (ropes or indoor adventure) is not confirmed.
A water-sports shop mapped as 'Indoor Surfing' (室内冲浪) in Minhang's Pujiang area indicates an indoor surf-wave facility; operator details are not confirmed.
